notes: Opens PDFs from Explorer: double-click / Open with now opens the file (a second file opens in the running window), and the installer registers PDF Forge for .pdf in Open with and Settings > Default apps. Flat forms become fillable: a PDF with no real form fields gets its blanks found automatically (boxes, table cells, writing lines, check boxes, SSN/EIN digit boxes), named after their labels; saving writes them as real form fields. Remove fields undoes it.
